0% Due to the online delivery and focus on theoretical concepts in the Fundamentals of Genetic Analysis course, participants' feedback to the training effectiveness survey were solely focused on shifting training to in-person practical demonstrations. As such, ICMP did not receive any data to measure training application. Nonetheless, beginning 2022, ICMP resumed conducting activities in-person with MLD, specifically on mentoring activities during anthropological analysis of human remains recovered during excavations with MGD.
